name: chromosome-ideogram
title: Chromosome Ideogram
description: A chromosome as its Giemsa bands in grayscale: two arms as capsules pinched at the centromere, narrow stalks, hatched variable heterochromatin, band names where they fit, a megabase ruler, markers as stacked pills on stems, a framed region with zoom lines down to a gene model, a hover card and a keyboard stop over the bands. Karyotype lays the genome side by side at one scale with markers, as a radio group to pick a chromosome. parseCytobands reads UCSC's cytoBand.txt; bandAt names the band at a position.
